description: Convert text to speech using the configured TTS engine (Chatterbox Turbo or Kokoro). For Chatterbox Turbo, use paralinguistic tags directly in text for expressive speech: [laugh], [sigh], [cough], [chuckle], [gasp], [groan], [clear throat], [sniff], [shush]. Supports voice cloning via reference audio.

model_path.description: Path to Kokoro ONNX model file (default: 'kokoro-v1.0.onnx', Kokoro only).

referenceAudio.description: Optional path to reference audio file for voice cloning (Chatterbox only).

speed.description: Speech speed (0.5 to 2.0, default: 1.0, Kokoro only).

text.description: The text to convert to speech. Must be non-empty and under the character limit. For Chatterbox Turbo, you can include paralinguistic tags like [laugh], [sigh], [cough] for expressive speech.

voice.description: Voice name (e.g., 'af_sarah', 'am_adam', 'bf_emma', 'jf_alpha', default: 'af_sarah', Kokoro only). Can also blend voices using 'voice1:weight,voice2:weight' format.

voices_path.description: Path to Kokoro voices bin file (default: 'voices-v1.0.bin', Kokoro only).

name: synthesize_text
